name: How long does it take to complete kitchen electrical and lighting upgrades?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete kitchen electrical and lighting upgrades?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for kitchen electrical and lighting upgrades depends on the project's complexity. Minor upgrades, such as installing new light fixtures or a few outlets, might take a day or two. More extensive work, like a complete kitchen rewire or significant lighting redesign, could take several days to a week. We will provide a project timeline during your consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor upgrades take 1-2 days; extensive projects can take several days to a week. We provide timelines during consultation.
